name: Niiyan
source:
Kansai's baseball coach, who taught him how to be a leader and a real man.

[spoiler]He is the fiancé of Jennu's older sister, and he feels guilty due to her death while she was visiting him in Kyoto. He managed to survive the apocalypse but was brainwashed by MAIK.[/spoiler]
